findings.claim: W5-MEASURES cook-verify charter A1/A2 upheld first-hand: absent observation -> UNKNOWN (never a fabricated pass, never zero) for all 5 output kinds; explosion detector anchored to offending_frame+signal; exposure ladder extends synapse.science.exposure without editing it (exposure tests byte-green). Charter delivery is sound - the supersession note's 'second agent BUILT the charter' checks out.

9/17 malformed-TYPE observations RAISE an unhandled exception instead of rendering UNKNOWN/FAIL. A crash is neither UNKNOWN nor zero - the honesty guard aborts before a verdict, so the crucible criterion 'unobtainable renders UNKNOWN' is NOT met for the wrong-TYPE input class. Cases: sim frames as str/int/list-of-scalars (explosion.py:95,102,112); geo bbox non-iterable + weight_sum string (measures.py:163,169); channels range non-iterable/short + samples float (measures.py:181,186); measure() on None obs (measures.py:76).
findings.scope_caveat: Wrong-TYPE inputs a trusted hython cook would not emit. Defense-in-depth hardening, NOT proof the shipped guard fabricates passes on realistic cook output. The builder scoped ABSENT+HOLLOW; this is a different surface.

findings.claim: 3/17 garbage-typed values ACCEPTED as MEASURED: img stats=0.5 scalar (measures.py:122), geo bbox='box' string (measures.py:163), channels variance='bad' string (measures.py:188). Present-but-garbage read as a measurement - the FP2-adjacent risk at LOW severity. Same out-of-producer-domain caveat as F1.

The 'never zero' line is handled CORRECTLY: geo counts=0 -> MEASURED is right (present-0 = cooked-empty geometry; absent = None -> UNKNOWN), via _has's `is not None` test. The contract never coerces absent -> 0.
